chapters.text: Rules act on leads by themselves: share new leads, reassign leads nobody called, remind agents.
Open the Rules tab and click New rule, or start from a ready-made one like Speed to lead.
Choose when: a new lead, a stage, not contacted in time, or quiet for a while.
Choose which leads, for example only Facebook or only DHA.
Choose what happens: give it to agents in turn, plan a task, alert people, or email the client. Save.
